gaps: Expiration check (reason 103) is referenced but its condition is not specified by any rule; not implemented.
No rule specifies setting ctx.return_code (e.g. when rejects occur); left at its initial value.
Width/padding of WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC is not specified; the description text is passed to write_reject unpadded.
The 2-character timestamp fraction is assumed to be hundredths of a second (microsecond // 10000) from ctx.now().
Duplicate TRAN-ID on write_transaction is assumed to be raised as Abend by the ctx shell; the port does not catch it.
Account rewrite 'record not found' (reason 109) is modelled as the account ID no longer being present in ctx.accounts.
Transaction count and reject count are kept internally only; no rule specifies displaying or outputting them.
The formula for the monthly interest amount (WS-MONTHLY-INT) is not specified by any rule; assumed zero.

The contents of the interest transaction record are not specified; only TRAN-AMT (the monthly interest) and TRAN-CARD-NUM (XREF-CARD-NUM) are set. All other fields, including TRAN-ID, type/category codes and timestamps, are left at their defaults.
Fee computation is mentioned in BR-003 but not specified; no fees are computed.
Behaviour when the account record or the card cross-reference for an account is not found is not specified; assumed abend.
Use of parm_date, now() and return_code is not specified by any rule; they are not used and return_code stays 0.
Disclosure read statuses other than found or not-found cannot occur with the dict lookup, so the 'ERROR READING DISCLOSURE GROUP FILE' abend path is never reached.
